t2.thesis: A steep 20% pre-earnings runup fueled by sympathy with IonQ's results sets an unsustainably high bar for Rigetti given its nascent revenue base, extreme valuation, and widening losses.
reasons: RGTI surged 20.7% over the past 5 sessions primarily in sympathy with IonQ's guidance raise, inflating near-term expectations without fundamental company-specific backing.
Trading at an extreme price-to-sales multiple of over 320x with an operating margin of -546%, the stock is highly vulnerable to post-earnings 'sell-the-news' mean reversion.
While high short interest (21.4%) provides some squeeze potential, retail call-skew froth (put/call volume 0.34) signals overextended sentiment heading into the print.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 recognized revenue and timeline/revenue conversion updates on the C-DAC system deployment and CHIPS Act funding milestones.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down from the 0.538 AMC base rate to 0.48 (-5.8 points) because the sharp 5-day pre-earnings rally on peer sympathy elevates the hurdle rate for a low-revenue, deep-loss quantum name.

theses.mechanism: Revenue fails to show meaningful sequential acceleration beyond $5-6M, causing the recent 20% sympathy rally to rapidly unwind.
theses.wrong_if: Management announces unexpected large commercial system orders or immediate CHIPS Act revenue recognition that justifies the valuation.

theses.mechanism: In-line financial results accompanied by standard roadmap updates keep the stock roughly flat within its implied 12% move band.
theses.wrong_if: Heavy short-covering triggers a multi-sigma squeeze regardless of financial metrics.

theses.mechanism: Delivery completion of the $8.4M C-DAC contract boosts quarterly revenue significantly above consensus, triggering aggressive short covering.
theses.wrong_if: Cash burn rate accelerates faster than anticipated, refocusing investors on dilution risks.

key_observations: Q3 total revenue versus the ~$5M quarterly run-rate
Updates on the delivery and revenue timing of the 108-qubit system for C-DAC in India
Net operating loss and quarterly cash burn rate
Details on disbursement timing and potential dilution from the $100M CHIPS Act definitive agreement
